36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
70733: Satan Jacob is the main protagonist of the series. He was once the Demon King who declared war on Ente Isla in an attempt to annex the four continents.
70735: Emilia is the main female protagonist and the Hero who defeated the Demon King Satan. After forcing the Demon King to retreat from Ente Isla, she followed him to modern day Japan to ensure his destruction.
70737: Alciel is one of Satan's Demon Generals and was also transported to modern day Japan with him. Extremely loyal to Maou, he takes care of the domestic duties at home and goes to the library to research ways for Maou and himself to regain their powers.
70739: Chiho is Maou's friend and a fellow employee at MgRonald's. She has a crush on Maou. She can hear and understand the language of Ente Isla, after receiving feedback from a hypnosis spell that Maou cast on her father, Inspector Sasaki.
82295: She is Maou's immediate superior at MgRonalds where he works.
83103: Lucifer is a fallen angel and one of the Demon King's generals. After his defeat at the hands of Hero Emilia, he was secretly rescued by Olba Meyer, who promised to return Lucifer to heaven if they became allies in defeating the Demon Lord.
83105: She is the chief interrogator and executioner for the Church Investigation Commission, who came into the human realm from Ente Isla to check on reports about Emi's alliance with Maou.
83461: Miki is the landlord at the place the Devil King stays, "Villa Rosa Sasazuka". She requested that her apartment be rented out to "shady characters" such as Maou and Alciel. She seems to have some knowledge of Ente Isla.
83467: One of the comrades of Yusa, Emi on attacking the Dark Lord's castle.
83887: Chiho's classmate, who seemly has an affinity for boy's love.
